description: Change a draft collection's rule, copy, controls or target_query; omitted fields keep their value, and an empty string clears a field back to its template. A published page's words and controls are changed in Avo. Curator only.

controls.description: What the page offers over its cards; a key left out keeps its default.

group.description: day groups the cards by the day each was logged.

description.description: The meta description, at most 160 characters.

batch.description: A YC batch ("Fall 2026") or a speedrun cohort ("SR008").

stage.description: One round stage, on a startups page built on a stage ("series_b" for Series B startups); sent without tags.

tags.description: Tag slugs from list_bookmark_tags; a bookmark carrying any of them is in.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").

target_query.description: The one search this page is written for.

name: update_collection
title: Revise a draft collection
